corrections.reason: The 2nd-order vowel marker on ሁ in እደዚሁም ('likewise') is clearly visible on the right leg of the glyph and required by Amharic grammar.
The printed word is ንዕድ (feminine of ንዑድ 'praised/blessed', paired with ክብርት to gloss ብፅዕት), with ዕ rather than ፅ.
The glyph in ስለሚያደርገው is the 6th-order ር with its characteristic top bend, matching standard Amharic imperfective relative morphology.
